data.body:
Goal:
Run the shipped lossless generation integrator through trusted GitHub Actions and Diffinite service runners so protected inbox refs are consumed only as untrusted data and authoritative generations advance safely.

Verification:
1. Run provider-adapter fixtures and provider-specific integration tests; expect only authenticated, current policy facts and trusted runner identities to authorize execution.
2. Run concurrent-writer, stale-control-CAS, and recovery-epoch tests; expect immutable canonical/archive publication before exactly one control CAS and no acknowledged event loss.
3. Run full replay-equivalence tests from published generations; expect projection-complete deterministic snapshots, packs, indexes, writer vectors, and conflict ledgers.
4. Run disposable live GitHub and Diffinite canaries; expect exact OID sequencing, ordinary-writer rejection, trusted-runner success, and byte-equivalent replay.
5. Run make sanity.

Constraints:
Inbox refs and their trees are untrusted data only: never checkout or execute inbox content. Consume only protected inbox refs discovered through provider-authenticated policy facts. Publish immutable canonical generation and archive objects first, then advance control with exact compare-and-swap last. Recovery creates a higher epoch that dominates acknowledged writer heads. Retain all legacy refs, inbox objects, generations, packs, archives, raw events, and Git objects indefinitely. Existing GitHub, Diffinite, service-identity, deployment, SQLite, and live-canary approvals apply; no additional operator gate.
data.title: Run trusted Knots generation integration
